Book a reservation into one of a venue's services. Authorized against the venue, since the
reservation does not exist yet.

post.description:
Apply a status-change action to a reservation (confirm/reject/cancel/check-in/no-show/
withdraw). The request body is discriminated on ``action`` (the verb); the required permission
is resolved per action (e.g. ``reservation:confirm``), authorized against the reservation
itself. A check-in also records the arrival time; any action may attach ``notes``.

get.description: Returns as soon as the app is able to serve requests. Deliberately checks no downstream dependency: container orchestration uses it to decide whether the process is up, not whether the whole stack is.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: Whether a closing removes every service that would otherwise run on this date. False when nothing was scheduled at all.

closed_services.title: Closed Services
closed_services.description: Services a closing removes that day which still hold bookings. They are not in `services`, since they no longer run.

deleted_services.title: Deleted Services
deleted_services.description: Deleted services that still hold bookings on that day. They are not in `services`, since they no longer run.

CalendarDay.title: CalendarDay
CalendarDay.description: One business date of the calendar window.

CalendarResponse.title: CalendarResponse
CalendarResponse.description:
Per-day occupancy of a venue over the requested window — the day's shape and what is left
to book. Days with no service running and no closing are omitted, so a caller can render
"nothing scheduled" by absence.

opens_at.title: Opens At
opens_at.description: Venue-local opening datetime, naive. May cross midnight for an overnight opening, in which case it closes on the following calendar day.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Seats the service can take on the date.

booked.title: Booked
booked.description: Seats taken by live bookings on the date.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: Seats still free on the date; negative when over capacity.

reservation_count.title: Reservation Count
reservation_count.description: Number of live bookings on the date.

over_capacity.title: Over Capacity
over_capacity.description: Whether the booked seats exceed the capacity.
